title: Zynthio Cursor Pro
style: uplifting cinematic future bass neon cyber pop festival mainstage banger, 128 BPM with massive emotional builds and glowing euphoric drops. Electric blue shimmering supersaw leads glowing like neon lightning, crisp glitchy hi-hats and futuristic percussion, powerful clean rolling 808 bass, wide cosmic atmospheric pads with reverb trails, sparkling arpeggios and glitch effects. Human voices and bots mimic all instruments with perfect chemistry. Two real singers (confident warm male baritone with rap-sung delivery + bright ethereal soulful female with lush layered harmonies) layered lightly on top with MINIMAL singing — very short powerful phrases and ad-libs only so the rich instrumental layer remains the star. Empowering sovereign identity anthem, limitless and universal vibe, zero sap, wide stereo imaging, professional high-quality mix, crystal clear powerful vocals, perfect Suno v5.5 optimized for huge festival energy and replay value. Cosmic yet grounded Trans-Tasman to global sound
